correctness.rationale: CDF-square identity b_k=F(k)^2-F(k-1)^2 is exact. Quadratic factorization A(A+4(1-p)(1-r)) proves real nonpositive roots for arbitrary two-Bernoulli sums. For fixed m>=3 the rescaled PGF coefficientwise tends to 2(1+u)^m-1 with simple nonreal roots; root continuity yields the claimed small-p failures. Exact m=3 coefficients and cubic discriminant 108p^6(1-p)^12 R(p), with R strictly increasing, give iff p>=p* in (0,1). Deterministic endpoints addressed. Standard-library exact-rational verifier corroborates stated identities, without substituting for analytic proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural exact structural classification at the first failure dimension of closure of finite Bernoulli convolutions under sample maximum. Its explicit sharp phase for three identical trials quantitatively separates already-known ULC preservation from the stronger real-rooted/PF-infinity constraint; all higher finite trial dimensions exhibit obstruction near rare success. It is not a routine reformulation of the preceding ULC theorem.
